hypotheses.hypothesis: Local reaction-diffusion rules spontaneously generate photonic band gaps without global optimization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed experimentally; structures maintain robustness and adaptability

title: Theory for magneto-optical detection of the interfacial orbital Rashba-Edelstein effect
task: Detect interfacial orbital Rashba-Edelstein effect via magneto-optical methods
key_results: Co/Pt bilayers show current-induced orbital angular momentum exceeding spin contribution by factor ~3; Pt proximity-induced moments contribute strongly to optical signal
comments: First-principles prediction of magneto-optical signature is valuable, but experimental validation in the cited system is not yet demonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Proximity-induced magnetism in nominally nonmagnetic layer enhances orbital Edelstein detection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Pt layer dominates optical signal despite Co being primary magnetic element

title: Topology in electrically pumped photonic-crystal lasers
task: Engineer electrically pumped photonic-crystal lasers using topological protection
key_results: Topological design toolkits (Chern/valley Hall, topological crystalline insulators, Dirac-vortex cavities, bound states in continuum) enable compact robust lasing with enhanced quality factors and mode selectivity
comments: Comprehensive review synthesizing topological photonics and semiconductor lasers; opportunities in non-Hermitian and nonlinear regimes outlined but largely unexplored.

model_io.model: Photonic crystal laser with topological band structure

hypotheses.hypothesis: Topological edge/corner states enable robust and efficient lasing without footprint enlargement
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; topological modes support high-quality lasing with protection against disorder
